top_signals.title: Thanksgiving Gas Prices Could Break a Record Despite Recent Plunge
top_signals.summary: Gasoline prices have fallen nearly 60 cents in a month, but Americans heading out for Thanksgiving could still pay more at the pump than during any previous Thanksgiving. The national average fell to $3.69 per gallon on Friday, according to AAA, down from approximately $4.30 a month ago. GasBuddy expects prices to average $3.62 on Thanksgiving Day, which would surpass the previous holiday record of $3.56 set in 2022. The declines are substantial.
